name: graphin-guide
description: Usage guidance for the graphin MCP server: skills for progressive-disclosure navigation (search → explore → read) and for the docs/wiki knowledge layer — knowledge sets over documentation sections, a project glossary, the propose-and-review queue, and the pre-flight gate that blocks delegation or edits until the knowledge for the work has been loaded. Plus two read-only subagents: an explorer that returns cited summaries instead of raw search output, and a budget-aware retrieval agent that answers content questions by moving between the symbol, keyword, semantic and graph retrievers as each response directs. Install alongside the graphin plugin.
